head: hex, TR headmark
notes: Thread only, from a Zip kit (steering column lower clamp 3772212 + bolt 9419005) whose single bolt is 1/4-20 hex TR; kit-level attribution, length not given. Zip also lists 9419005 for 56-57 bumper, 56-58 deck lid hinge and 58-62 hood support kits (no sizes). Searched: 'GM 9419005', '9419005 bolt', '9419005 1/4-20'; parttarget NSN page empty.
